papers.title: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World
papers.authors: Lin, Yin, Li, Yu et al.
papers.what: Lets a multimodal model reason by writing executable SVG code as an intermediate step, rendering it, and revising it over several turns, reaching 55.1% on VSIBench and 76.0% on MindCube.

papers.title: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine
papers.what: Fixes GRPO stalling on hard prompts by using a short distillation phase to pull verified off-support solutions into the student's range before on-policy reinforcement learning; raises Qwen3-8B AIME 2025 from 36.9 to 40.3.

papers.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
papers.what: Speculative decoding for high-concurrency serving: a sequential head restores within-block dependency and confidence-scheduled verification cuts waste, giving 60 to 85 percent faster per-user generation in DeepSeek-V4's serving system.

papers.title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion: A Tri-Mode Language Model Unifying Autoregressive, Diffusion, and Self-Speculation Decoding
papers.what: Trains one model under a joint autoregressive-diffusion objective so it switches decoding modes; the 8B model decodes 6x more tokens per forward pass than Qwen3-8B at comparable accuracy.
